text.tspan: Article 14 triage record - which vulnerabilities in this SBOM are known to be exploited.
What this run consulted, and when. The sources below are point-in-time snapshots: the same SBOM run tomorrow can
land differently, and this block is what says which day this was.

Point-in-time snapshot of OSV and the EUVD KEV catalogue. art14 stores no vulnerability data of its own; the cache is a

Each bar is a share of the base printed beside it, and the base changes twice on the way down. The asymmetry is the
point of the tool: a few hundred findings collapse to the handful a person has to decide about.
